data.title: First payment reminder from TechMarkt Online – €94.99 due by 30 September 2026
data.summary: TechMarkt Online GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for unpaid invoice TM-2026-0048213 dated 20 August 2026. The total is €94.99 (€89.99 plus a €5.00 reminder fee), to be paid by 30 September 2026.
data.explanation: The retailer says it did not receive payment for an invoice that was due on 3 September 2026. It now asks for €94.99, which includes a €5.00 reminder fee (Mahngebühr), by 30 September 2026. If you already paid, you can ignore the letter. If not, pay soon, because the deadline is very close. Otherwise the claim will go to a debt collection agency (Inkassodienstleister), which causes further costs. If you think the claim or the fee is wrong, contact the company in writing. Check that the IBAN matches earlier invoices before paying.
